Compare two models' contents

Source: R/compare_models.R
compare_models.Rd

Diffs two models (or repositories) at the declaration level: every stored object (technologies, commodities, supply, demand, ...) is matched by name and compared by content hash (object_hash(), which ignores @misc bookkeeping), yielding an added / removed / changed / same inventory. For models, the configuration (regions, horizon, calendar, discount rates, optimizeRetirement) is compared as well. With details = TRUE every changed object also gets a recursive slot-by-slot drill-down, printable per object via print(x, name = "...").

Usage

compare_models(a, b, names = c("A", "B"), tol = 1e-08, details = TRUE)

# S3 method for class 'models_cmp'
print(x, name = NULL, ...)

Arguments

a, b

model or repository objects.

names

character(2), display names of the two sides.

tol

numeric tolerance for the drill-down's data comparisons.

details

logical, compute the per-object slot drill-down for changed objects.

x

a models_cmp object.

name

character, a changed object's name: print its slot-by-slot drill-down instead of the summary.

...

ignored.

Value

A models_cmp object (a list): inventory (name, class, hash_a, hash_b, status), config (item, A, B, differs; NULL for repositories), details (named list of slot diffs for changed objects), counts (status table), names.

See also

compare_scenarios(), compare_inputs(), object_hash().

Other comparison: compare_inputs(), compare_scenarios()

Examples

topia_elc <- topia$modules$electricity
mod <- newModel("TOPIA", data = topia_elc$repo,
                calendar = topia$modules$calendars$s4_h24,
                region = topia_elc$regions,
                horizon = topia$modules$horizons$BY2025_50_by10,
                discount = 0.05)
mod <- setGeoscale(mod, topia_elc$geoscale)

# reprice the gas supply curve and see what moved
sup_gas <- getObject(topia_elc$repo, name = "SUP_GAS", drop = TRUE)
sup_gas@supply$cost <- sup_gas@supply$cost * 1.25
mod2 <- add(mod, sup_gas, overwrite = TRUE)
cmp <- compare_models(mod, mod2, names = c("base", "dear gas"))
cmp
#> model comparison: base vs dear gas
#> changed: 1  same: 47 
#> 
#> --- Objects ---
#>     name  class   hash_a   hash_b  status
#>  SUP_GAS supply 4d4340e5 c74858d7 changed
#> Configuration: identical.
#> 
#> Drill down with print(x, name = "SUP_GAS")

# drill into the one object that changed
print(cmp, name = "SUP_GAS")
#> slot differences for 'SUP_GAS' (base vs dear gas):

#> + new[7, ]  4.60

#> - old[9, ]  6.44
